searchLedger.hypothesis: A data-only fixture is loaded with Function() over a slice bounded by indexOf('[') and lastIndexOf(']'), so a second ] or any non-literal entry executes arbitrary text in the capture process

searchActions.result: slice + Function(...)() executes the fixture text; the data-only assumption is documented but unenforced
introduced 38e2577a55a (2026-08-15); pre-existing, not introduced by f34b01bf0a

searchLedger.rationale: Unnecessary eval primitive with a brittle slice boundary; contained today only because the fixture is in-repo source

searchLedger.hypothesis: The widened recursive runtime scan follows symlinked directories, reading outside RUNTIME_ROOT and risking unbounded recursion on a hostile tree

searchActions.result: statSync(path).isDirectory() follows symlinks; no depth guard or realpath containment
embeddings -> .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/shared/embeddings (exists; 10+ .ts files the scan now reads); no cycle inside the target

searchLedger.rationale: Gate input boundary is implicit; traversal is PR-controllable but the worst case is the job failing or hanging, not data exposure

searchLedger.hypothesis: PR-controlled text or event context reaches a shell or subprocess command line

searchActions.result: no event-context interpolation; no pull_request_target or workflow_run; no continue-on-error or secrets references
all subprocess.run calls use argv arrays without shell=True; prompt text travels via stdin JSON

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: All run: steps are static text and every subprocess call uses an argv array without a shell

searchLedger.hypothesis: Fork PRs execute untrusted code with a write token or repository secrets

searchActions.queryOrPath: workflow triggers, permissions block, job steps
searchActions.result: permissions: contents: read only, no job override, no secrets.*, no continue-on-error; actions and setup actions SHA-pinned

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Read-only token and no secrets referenced; unpinned-npx surface is version-pinned and the new steps resolve the npm-ci-installed local vitest

searchLedger.hypothesis: Skill metadata from an untrusted PR reaches SQL string construction in the graph indexer

searchActions.result: all statements use prepare() with ? placeholders; exec() calls are static DDL; no template interpolation of metadata

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Parameterized statements throughout; only static SQL text is executed

searchLedger.hypothesis: SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_DB_DIR as attacker-influenced input can redirect the scorer's SQLite reads and writes

searchActions.result: env is operator-set; the ratchet supplies a mkdtemp path before module load; capture deletes it to force the local fallback; no privilege boundary crossed

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Operator-controlled environment with the same trust level as the running user; no cross-boundary input
